title: Proof-Carrying Contracts: Commitments AI Agents Cannot Break
title_zh: 可证明承载合约：智能体无法违背的承诺

paragraphs.en: PC2框架要求AI代理在执行操作前提供机器可验证证明，确保合同约束在整个交互过程中不可违背。 总结： AI agents increasingly act on behalf of people or other agents, purchasing services, exchanging information and delegating work. What an agent must respect is written in instructions, policies or agreements, but text alone cannot make it comply. It may make mistakes, be redirected by what it reads, or pursue different interests. For an economy of such agents to function, parties need agreements they can rely on without inspecting or trusting one another's agents. We introduce Proof-Carrying Contracts (PC2), a framework for making agreed constraints enforceable throughout an agent's interactions with a system. Before a requested operation can run, the agent must supply a machine-checkable proof that it preserves the agreed constraints in every case allowed by its model. An execution system called the Airlock checks the proof and controls access to the operation. The parties specify the conditions to preserve, while the agent supplies the reasoning needed to justify its decisions and remains free to adapt its strategy. This avoids having to design a separate permission policy and prove that every decision it permits is safe. We prove that the constraints hold at every instant during execution, even for an adversarial agent, and identify when this implies safety in the world. Reusable capability modules provide tools and guarantees from which contracts can be constructed. PC2 provides a foundation for an agent economy whose agreements protect both those delegating work and those carrying it out.
paragraphs.zh: PC2框架要求智能体在执行操作前提供机器可验证的证明，确保合同约束在整个交互过程中不可违背。总结：智能体日益代表人类或其他智能体行事，购买服务、交换信息并委托工作。 智能体必须遵守的内容写在指令、策略或协议中，但仅凭文本无法使其遵从。 它可能犯错，可能被它读到的内容引偏方向，或追求不同的利益。 要让这样一个智能体经济体运转，各方需要能够依赖的协议，而无需检查或信任彼此的智能体。 我们提出携带证明的合同（Proof-Carrying Contracts，PC2），这是一个使约定约束在智能体与系统的整个交互过程中可被强制执行的框架。 在请求的操作得以运行之前，智能体必须提供一份机器可检验的证明，表明在其模型所允许的每一种情形下，该操作都保持约定约束。 一个名为Airlock的执行系统负责检验该证明并控制对操作的访问。 各方指定需要保持的条件，而智能体提供为自身决策辩护所需的推理，并保持自由调整其策略的能力。 这避免了必须单独设计一个权限策略并证明其所允许的每一个决策都是安全的。 我们证明约束在执行过程中的每一时刻都成立，即使面对对抗性的智能体也是如此，并确定这在何时意味着现实世界中的安全性。 可复用的能力模块提供了工具与保证，合同可以由此构建。 PC2为智能体经济体奠定了基础，其协议既保护委托工作的一方，也保护执行工作的一方。
